What to consider

Wi-Fi vs. 4G LTE: Most solar cameras still require Wi-Fi. For remote properties without Wi-Fi, choose a cellular model.

Continuous recording: Most solar battery cameras primarily record motion events, not uninterrupted 24/7 video.

Sunlight: The panel needs adequate direct sunlight to maintain battery charge.

Subscription: Eufy, Reolink, and Tapo offer local recording options without mandatory cloud subscriptions.
